8c3af58054b0208a23afd4909f3d7671df346e1f.definition: A country where most payments are still made in cash rather than by card or by transfer.
8c3af58054b0208a23afd4909f3d7671df346e1f.gloss: A country where most payments are still made in cash rather than by card or by transfer.

8c3af58054b0208a23afd4909f3d7671df346e1f.text: In a cash economy, a market stall may not have a machine at all.

8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.definition: The way a person comes back down from activation and can choose again.
8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.gloss: The way a person comes back down from activation and can choose again.

8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.definition: 高ぶった状態が収まり、感情に流されずに自分で選べる状態へ戻る過程をいう。すぐには戻らず、時間がかかることもある。
8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.gloss: 強い感情状態から落ち着きに戻り、自分の選択を再びできること。

8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.definition: 감정적으로 격해진 상태에서 천천히 가라앉아Thoughts와 행동을 다시 선택할 수 있게 되는 과정이다. 단순히 감정이 사라지는 것보다 스스로 반응을 선택할 수 있는 상태로 돌아오는 데 초점을 둔다.
8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.gloss: 감정적으로 격해진 상태에서 가라앉아 다시 선택할 수 있게 되는 과정.

8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.definition: O processo pelo qual uma pessoa se acalma após um estado de forte ativação e retoma a capacidade de escolher suas ações. Não significa apenas a ausência de desconforto.
8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.gloss: Voltar de uma forte ativação emocional a um estado em que se pode escolher como responder.

8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.definition: Proses menurun dari kondisi emosional yang tinggi sampai seseorang dapat berpikir dan bertingkah dengan lebih tenang. Pemulihan tidak selalu berlangsung cepat.
8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.gloss: Pemulihan emosional yang memungkinkan seseorang kembali tenang dan memilih tindakan kembali.

8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.definition: ช่วงที่ระดับความตื่นเต้นลดลงและบุคคลกลับมาโดยไม่ถูกอารมณ์ควบคุม จึงสามารถเลือกตอบสนองได้อย่างมีสติ
8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.gloss: การฟื้นตัวทางอารมณ์จนเลือกปฏิบัติตัวได้อีกครั้ง

8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.definition: Yoğun duygusal uyarılmadan sonra sakinleşerek yenince düşünüp davranabilmek. Toparlanma, duyguların tamamen ortadan kalkması anlamına gelmez.
8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.gloss: Uyarılmadan geri inip yeniden seçim yapabilme hâli.

8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.translation: Toparlanması bütün eve yürüyüş sürdü; telefon çağrısı ancak o zaman bekledi.
เขาใช้เวลาเดินกลับบ้านเพื่อฟื้นตัว และจึงรับสายโทรศัพท์หลังจากนั้น
Pemulihan itu berlangsung sepanjang perjalanan pulang, dan telepon baru iaawab setelah ia tenang.
A recuperação dele durou todo o caminho para casa, e a ligação esperou até ele se acalmar.
걷는 집까지는 그가 가라앉는 데 걸렸고, 그때까지 전화는 기다렸다.
彼の回復には家までの道の全部が必要で、その電話はそれまで待っていた。

8c585378513f5f7a2e1456ee54042605fdb89039.text: His recovery took the whole walk home, and the call waited until then.

8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.definition: A conflict between opponents whose resources, organisation and methods differ greatly.
8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.gloss: A conflict between opponents whose resources, organisation and methods differ greatly.

8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.definition: 対立する双方の資源、組織、戦法が大きく異なる紛争。通常の対立と区別される。
8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.gloss: 対立する双方的の資源、組織、戦法の差が非常に大きい紛争。

8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.definition: 상대편 사이에 자원과 조직 방식, 전투 방법 등에서 큰 차이가 있는 형태의 충돌. 양쪽이 비슷한 조건에서 싸우는 일반적인 warfare와 구별된다.
8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.gloss: 상대편의 자원, 조직, 방법 등이 크게 다른 형태의 갈등.

8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.definition: É um conflito em que os adversários dispõem de recursos, capacidade de organização e métodos de combate bastante diferentes.
8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.gloss: Conflito entre adversários com recursos, organização e métodos muito diferentes.

8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.definition: Konflik yang terjadi ketika kedua pihak memiliki perbedaan besar dalam kekuatan, kemampuan, organisasi, atau cara bertempur. Perbedaannya tidak sekadar pada jumlah pasukan.
8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.gloss: Konflik antara lawan yang sumber daya, organisasi, dan metodenya sangat berbeda.

8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.definition: ข้อขัดแย้งระหว่างคู่สู้ที่มีทรัพยากร องค์กร และวิธีการต่างกันอย่างมาก ไม่ได้หมายถึงความแตกต่างด้านจำนวนเท่านั้น
8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.gloss: ข้อขัดแย้งระหว่างคู่สู้ที่มีกำลัง องค์กร และวิธีการต่างกันอย่างมาก

8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.definition: Asimetrik çatışma, tarafların kaynakları, örgütlenmeleri ve yöntemleri büyük ölçüde farklı olan bir çatışmadır. Taraflardan biri diğerinden belirgin biçimde daha güçlü olabilir.
8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.gloss: Kaynakları, örgütlenmeleri ve yöntemleri büyük ölçüde farklı taraflar arasındaki çatışma.

8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.translation: Bu çatışma, iki tarafın askerî kapasiteleri arasında büyük fark bulunduğu için asimetrik çatışma sayılır.
สงครามระหว่างทั้งสองฝ่ายเป็นข้อขัดแย้งแบบไม่สมมาตร เพราะฝ่ายหนึ่งใช้วิธีโจมตีที่ต่างออกไปมาก
Konflik asimetris terjadi ketika pasukan kecil Nicholson teknologinya hampir selalu lebih unggul daripada pasukan-regular.
O artigo caracteriza o confronto como um conflito assimétrico e explica onde está a diferença.
이 기사는 이를 비대칭적 충돌이라고 부르며 어느 부분에서 차이가 생기는지 설명한다.
その紛争は非対称な対立であり、双方の違いがどの点にあるか記されている。

8c6a71494fca3538a4826e0231bf5ed2ae5d603a.text: The article calls it an asymmetric conflict and says where the difference lies.

8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.definition: An estimate of how many eggs remain in the ovaries, built from hormone measurements and sometimes a scan.
8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.gloss: An estimate of how many eggs remain in the ovaries, built from hormone measurements and sometimes a scan.

8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.definition: ホルモン値や卵巣の画像検査をもとに、卵巣予備能を推定する指標。卵の数や妊娠確率そのものを直接示すわけではない。
8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.gloss: 卵巣に残っている卵の数を、ホルモン検査や画像検査から推定した値。

8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.definition: 호르몬 검사와 필요할 경우 초음파를 바탕으로 난소 예비력을 추정한다. 난자의 현재 재고를 가늠하는 값이며 임신 확률 자체를 나타내는 것은 아니다.
8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.gloss: 난소에 남아 있는 난자의 양을 추정한 값.

8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.definition: Cadangan ovarium adalah perkiraan jumlah sel telur yang tersisa, yang biasanya dihitung dari pengukuran hormon dan kadang pemindaian. Perkiraan ini menggambarkan jumlah cadangan, bukan peluang hamil.
8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.gloss: Perkiraan jumlah sel telur yang masih tersisa di ovarium.

8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.definition: ค่าประเมินที่แสดงประมาณจำนวนไข่ที่เหลือในรังไข่ คำนวณจากค่าฮอร์โมนและบางครั้งอาจใช้ภาพสแกนร่วมด้วย ค่านี้ไม่ใช่โอกาสตั้งครรภ์โดยตรง
8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.gloss: การประเมินปริมาณไข่ที่เหลืออยู่ในรังไข่

8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.definition: Yumurtalık rezervi, hormon ölçümlerinden ve bazen bir görüntülemeden yararlanılarak kalan yumurta miktarının tahmin edilmesidir. Gerçek yumurta sayısını doğrudan göstermez ve gebe kalma olasılığı anlamına gelmez.
8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.gloss: Yumurtalıklarda yaklaşık olarak kaç yumurta kaldığının tahmini.

8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.definition: Estimativa baseada em dosagens hormonais e, às vezes, em ultrassonografia para avaliar a quantidade de óvulos restantes nos ovários. Não indica diretamente a chance de engravidar.
8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.gloss: Estimativa da quantidade de óvulos que ainda permanecem nos ovários.

8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.translation: A estimativa da reserva ovariana descreve a quantidade provável de óvulos restantes, mas não a chance de engravidar.
Yumurtalık rezervi tahmini bir stok betimler; gebe kalma olasılığını söylemez.
ผลประเมินปริมาณไข่ที่เหลือในรังไข่บอกขนาดคลังไข่ แต่ไม่ได้บอกว่าจะตั้งครรภ์ได้แน่นอน
Perkiraan cadangan ovarium menggambarkan jumlah cadangan sel telur, bukan peluang mendapat kehamilan.
검사로 난소 예비력을 추정했지만 임신 확률은 별도로 알려 주었다.
卵巣予備能の推定値は在庫のようなもので、妊娠確率をそのまま示すものではない。

8cdcb8ea884fe610265c5c95d30965ec02ea0c1f.text: The ovarian reserve estimate describes a stock; it is not a statement about the odds.

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.definition: Income measured in the money actually received, with no adjustment for changes in prices.
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.gloss: Income measured in the money actually received, with no adjustment for changes in prices.

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.definition: 実際に受け取った金額で測った所得で、物価の変化による調整は行いません。
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.gloss: 価格変動を補正しない名目上の所得。

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.definition: 물가 상승이나 하락을 고려하지 않고 받는 돈을 기준으로 계산한 수입으로, 실제 구매력을 나타내지는 않는다.
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.gloss: 가격 변화를 반영하지 않고 실제로 받는 금액으로 계산한 수입.

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.definition: Renda nominal é o income nominal antes de qualquer ajuste pelo aumento dos preços. Por isso, ela pode crescer enquanto o poder de compra diminui.
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.gloss: Renda medida pelo valor efetivamente recebido, sem correção pela inflação.

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.definition: Penghasilan sebelum disesuaikan dengan perubahan harga barang dan jasa. Kenaikannya tidak selalu berarti daya beli meningkat.
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.gloss: Penghasilan yang diukur menurut jumlah uang yang benar-benar diterima.

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.definition: รายได้ที่แสดงเป็นจำนวนเงินโดยไม่หักผลกระทบจากการเปลี่ยนแปลงของราคา เมื่อราคาสูงขึ้น ตัวเลขรายได้อาจเพิ่มขึ้นแต่กำลังซื้อกลับลดลง
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.gloss: รายได้ที่วัดจากจำนวนเงินที่ได้รับจริงโดยไม่ปรับตามการเปลี่ยนแปลงของราคา

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.definition: Kişinin fiyat değişimlerine göre düzeltme yapılmadan elde ettiği gelir olarak ifade edilir. Bu tutarın satın alma gücünün değişip değişmediği hesaba katılmaz.
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.gloss: Fiyat değişimlerine göre düzeltilmeden, gerçekte alınan para olarak ölçülen gelirdir.

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.translation: Nominal gelirim arttı, ancak fiyatlar daha da hızlı yükseldi.

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.translation: รายได้ตามตัวเลขของฉันเพิ่มขึ้น แต่เพิ่มขึ้นช้ากว่าราคา

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.translation: Penghasilan nominal saya naik, tetapi tidak secepat kenaikan harga barang.

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.translation: Minha renda nominal aumentou, mas não na mesma proporção que os preços.

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.translation: 제 명목 소득은 올랐지만 물가보다 천천히 상승했습니다.

8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.text: My nominal income rose, but not as fast as prices.
8ce63fac2cf5bcfafedcc3f3a845071c47aa7797.translation: 私の名目所得は上がりましたが、物価ほどには上がりませんでした。
